text:
Asha: quick flag — onboarding atlas-7b-q5 into canary showed a small but consistent drop on long-summary holdouts. F1 ~-2.3 and a handful of factual hallucinations on legal/retention paragraphs. suspect promptbank duplicates + quote normalization.

Tom: can you paste 2 failing examples? which quant profile?

Asha: short samples: 
```
Prompt: Summarize compliance section (approx 2.9k tokens) into 5 bullets
Gold: mentions retention 90d, notify within 72h, contact points
Atlas out: invents clause about "sharing telemetry for resale"
```
Profile: q5-default + per-layer scale tweak (vik/quant-branch). canary id atlas-canary-20240812.

Renee: thanks. first checks: (1) dedupe vs gold anchors (paraphrase collisions amplify changes), (2) tokenizer normalization (curly vs straight quotes), (3) prompt truncation leading to shifted context.

Vik: i'll run a quick quant smoke with kv_norm=true and headroom=0.13. if low-prob mass is the issue that often helps.

Tom: run local dedupe like this: 
```bash
python tools/curation/dedupe.py \ 
  --promptbank /data/promptbank/2024-07 \ 
  --targets /tmp/atlas_fails.csv \ 
  --sim-threshold 0.88 \ 
  --tokenizer-check normalize-quotes
```
This will print candidate anchor ids + sim scores.

labeling-bot: queued micro-golden review: 12 tasks (priority: high). ETA ~30h.

Renee: please prioritize (a) model-origin hallucination vs prompt leakage, (b) provenance mismatches, (c) tokenization-only diffs. if >25% model-origin -> block.

Asha: uploaded a CSV of 12 examples to /internal/curation/tmp/atlas_fails.csv and linked the canary card.

Vik: quick smoke: kv_norm recovered +1.0 F1, headroom 0.13 recovered +0.6. combining both nearly recovers baseline but latency +10ms/token. posting matrix to the canary card.

Tom: nice. Renee, can you run dedupe and share overlap percent? if many are near-duplicates we may need promptbank cleanup rather than rollback.

Renee: running now. local command above finished: 12 targets -> 3 high-sim collisions (>0.9) to anchors, 2 medium (0.85-0.9). tokenization audit: 5/12 had curly vs straight quote mismatch.

labeling-bot: micro-golden tasks complete: 12/12. results: 4 confirmed model-induced hallucinations, 3 provenance-only mismatches, 5 ambiguous. tagged tasks TG-776..TG-787.

Asha: 4/12 = 33% > 25% gate -> recommend pausing rollout.

Vik: given quant tweaks mostly recover but add latency, option: backfill small kv_norm + headroom for canary only and ask infra for perf tradeoff analysis.

Tom: action items:
- @Vik produce perf/quality table for profiles [q5-default, q5+kv_norm, q5+headroom0.13, combined] -> due +48h (1765526276)
- @Renee run full dedupe scan on the holdout set and share percent collisions -> due +24h (1765480000)
- @Asha expand sample to 50 only if dedupe <10% collisions AND micro-golden ambiguous fraction >30% -> hold until results

Renee: ack. i'll also export a small script to normalize quotes in ingest and run a quick re-eval to see how much exact-match improves.

deploy-bot: snapshot saved: atlas-canary-20240812-snap4. traffic set to 0% pending triage.

Asha: thanks all. leaning conservative: block until quant/normalization path either recovers quality or we confirm promptbank fault. ping here with updates. :white_check_mark:
